messages:
Maya Patel: quick heads-up — during onboarding calls this week 3 customers independently asked for a per-route cost breakdown in the console (not just per-model). they want to map feature usage to specific billing lines for finance.
Ethan Cho: saw that too with NeonHealth yesterday. they said current per-model breakdown doesn't help when they route different customers to different endpoints.
Maya Patel: exact ask: 'show token consumption and $/minute by route + ability to map to customer tags'
Priya Singh: thanks — sounds like a product request. can you capture the ask with impact + # of customers and any urgency? will pass to roadmap triage.
Maya Patel: quick capture below (copyable):
```
Customer: NeonHealth, ParkCo, TallyApps
Priority: Medium-high (affects renewals for 2 pilots)
Pain: Finance can't reconcile invoices to app routes; blocks chargeback to business units
Ask: Per-route token counts, $ cost estimate, exportable CSV, and ability to attach customer tag in billing view
Impact metric: Could unblock $150k ARR at renewal for NeonHealth this quarter
Contact: neon-eng@neonhealth.com (AM: Jenna)
```
Ethan Cho: adding a note — some customers want sampling (e.g., last 30 days) and per-model-split for hybrid routes (model fallback).
Priya Singh: useful. I'll create a ticket in Productboard and link here. can you add any sample CSV or screenshot?
Maya Patel: attaching screenshot of ParkCo billing ask: https://files.redwood/example-screens/parkco-billing.png  (they circled route names)
Liam O'Connor: from eng POV: we already emit route metrics to metrics pipeline; exposing token counts in UI + export should be straightforward but need to decide if costs are computed client-side (estimates) or pulled from billing system.
Priya Singh: let's start with an "estimates" MVP: use token/unit prices and route token sums. if customers need exact invoice mapping we can scope later.
Ethan Cho: agreed MVP should help renewals. flagging two renewals (NeonHealth, ParkCo) — I'll follow up with CS playbook to surface this in renewal calls.
Maya Patel: can we add a "customer urgency" tag on the product ticket? neonhealth flagged next renewal in 6 weeks.
Priya Singh: yes — I'll tag as "renewal-risk" and ask PM team to prioritise a quick UI patch.
cs-bot: new ticket created: PB-4821 "Per-route cost estimates + CSV export" by Priya Singh. link: https://productboard/redwood/4821
Maya Patel: perfect — adding notes in Salesforce and sending a short enablement doc to AMs.
Ethan Cho: if PM wants data samples for scope, I can export route token metrics for the three accounts.
Priya Singh: please do, Ethan. I'll add acceptance criteria: CSV, last-30-days sampling, include model fallback columns.
Maya Patel: thanks team — will update thread after AM sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
